# Contact the Qubrid AI team

Whether you’re planning a new AI initiative, scaling GPU infrastructure, or evaluating hybrid deployment options, our specialists can help you design the right architecture, pricing model, and onboarding plan.

Design reserved clusters, dedicated bare metal, or on-prem appliances with managed services.

### AI platform onboarding

Get help connecting workloads to Qubrid’s model catalog, orchestration APIs, and observability.

### Partnerships & resellers

Explore integrations, OEM opportunities, and co-sell programs tailored to your market.
